description: A rotting undead man lurches toward the viewer, framed from the chest up. His skin is a sickly mottled green with white highlights, his hair a dark ragged mop, his eyes hollow and his mouth hanging open. He wears a tattered black shirt, and both clawed green hands stretch toward the party, the nearer one huge in the foreground. Behind him is a night graveyard: flat grey ground dotted with small pale crosses and a stone marker, under a sky streaked with purple and deep blue, with a round pale moon in the upper left. The palette is green flesh against cold purples and blues, eerie and unsettling. Frame 1: the moon glows teal with a small grey marker at the far left. Frame 2: the moon brightens and the marker turns cyan. Frame 3: the moon shifts shade again. Frame 4: the moon dims toward teal. Frame 5: the moon flares to its brightest pale cyan. Every frame flashes equally briefly, so the loop reads as a fast, nervous shimmer of moonlight over a frozen, menacing figure.
title: Zombie reaching in a graveyard
